settings.label: Goods and Furniture tabs
settings.description: Traders stock goods and furniture separately, each on its own tab, so furniture never crowds out the goods.

settings.label: Goods per restock
settings.description: How many goods a trader puts out each restock (the game uses 40).

settings.label: Stock tab
settings.description: Items a trader only sells to people they trust: 3 more for each reputation level, getting better as you go.

settings.label: Sell trader keys
settings.description: Once you're Reliable, the Generalist sells the Cellar Key, the Doctor the Gymnasium Key and the Gunsmith the Tunnel Key.

settings.label: Trader reputation
settings.description: Each trader has a reputation from Unknown to Partner. Tasks, dailies and trading raise it. Off: stock follows completed tasks only.

settings.label: Daily tasks
settings.description: 1 to 6 small jobs per trader each day, more as your reputation grows.

settings.label: Kill contracts
settings.description: Once you're an Acquaintance, one daily can be a contract to kill Bandits, Guards or Military.

settings.label: Repairs
settings.description: The Gunsmith repairs weapons and the Doctor armor and helmets. Toggle Repair in the deal panel and click damaged items.

settings.label: Restock hotkey
settings.description: Press while trading to restock the trader now. A key name like F1 or R.
